changelog:
# v0.0.2

- Torrent engine updated to v1.

# v0.0.1

First release.

- Plays torrent links (magnets, .torrent files, info hashes) from all your other providers.
- Torrents are only fetched when you press play; the right file or episode is picked for you.
- Torrent engine downloaded on demand, only reachable from this device. Stops when idle, and on Wi-Fi only if you want.
- Torrent list, cache cleanup and full engine settings.
- Engine updates download automatically.
name: ServeTorr
description:
Plays torrent links from your other providers.

Magnets, .torrent files and info hashes found by other providers are streamed through a local torrent engine, so they play like any other link. Download the engine once from this provider's settings (about 9 MB).

🚨 EXPERIMENTAL!! This provider hooks into the app's internals and may stop working after an app update. 🚨

changelog:
# v1.1.0

- The StreamPlay plugin is now downloaded on first use instead of being bundled, and can be updated without a new release of this provider.
- New provider settings: installed and latest version, "Update automatically" (on by default), "Check for updates" and "Update now".
- With automatic updates off, a notification tells you when an update is available.
- A new build that fails to load is rolled back and not retried until you choose "Try again".
- If the downloaded plugin is missing or corrupted, it is downloaded again.
- Fixed the "No base context" error in sources that use a web view.
- Fixed sources that need the cryptography library failing to load.
- Provider API updated to core-stubs 1.4.0.
name: StreamPlay
description:
Phisher98's StreamPlay for Flixclusive: a multi-source aggregator for movies, TV shows and anime.

The StreamPlay plugin is downloaded the first time the provider is used and can be kept up to date from this provider's settings. Leave "Update automatically" on, or turn it off to get a notification when an update is available.
